claims.statement: Mrs. Duffy, housekeeper for Tom Allen, was the only witness at the coroner's inquest into the death of William C. Brown who said she saw Brown assaulted.
claims.excerpt: Mrs. Duffy, housekeeper for Tom Allen, the ex-pugilist. was the only witness who claimed to have seen Brown

notes: Allen appears only as the employer of the witness. Hint kept as legal (inquest).
